# EdgeORE Android review candidate

This draft contains a debug-signed APK, a downloadable review package, checksums and source-side build evidence. It is not a production release or a device-qualified wallet/provider demonstration.

Transactions remain devnet-only. ORE deployment depends on the required devnet program/accounts. Daily check-in points do not pay ORE. Bandwidth/cloud hosting and funded rewards require separate integrations. Signed receipts verify their signed contents; they do not independently prove work or payment.

Physical Seeker, actual MWA signing/confirmation, real receipt export, notification delivery and configured-provider device gates remain NOT_RUN unless this draft links a recorded result for its exact APK. No owner release key is used by this workflow. The project-license decision remains pending unless a LICENSE is present at the tagged source; upstream NOTICE remains applicable.

Review the attached source identity, checksums and gate summary before publishing or installing. dApp Store publication is separate from submission and from this draft.
